title: Hunts FH-047S: Confirmed-qualification reader, sponsor invoice and payment sync

source.ref: Split from FH-036..040 (2026-11-10): the pure core, storage and tests shipped dark behind HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED; the live call sites move here.

detail:
Read confirmed distinct qualification keys for a Hunt, call decideFreeze and freezeSnapshot once the threshold is met before Hunt end, invoice the frozen amount once (hunt_sponsor_settlements) and mark it paid only from the provider's own reference through nextSettlement, and show publicMoneyLines. Done when: event replay and a fraud correction cannot double invoice, and an unpaid pledge never appears as donations raised. Requires: FH-047, FH-045. Owner role: Finance and game systems.

Built 2026-11-16: lib/hunts/sponsor-settlement.ts. confirmedQualificationKeys reads one key per person whose run is completed with no claim still submitted or held and no reversed credit (paged, so a long list is never cut short). settleSponsorMilestone checks the agreement is active with a recorded approver, then decideFreeze and freezeSnapshot before the Trail ends, then writes one hunt_sponsor_settlements row for the frozen amount. Once-only is enforced by the database: unique (hunt_id) on agreements, unique (agreement_id) on snapshots, unique (snapshot_id) on settlements, and hunt_sponsor_freeze returns the first snapshot. The transfer-reconcile cron runs the pass. A paid provider invoice that names the settlement in its metadata, in USD and for at least the frozen amount, marks it paid through nextSettlement. The play page shows publicMoneyLines: gifts received, pledged and paid are separate lines. Tests cover replay, a fraud correction before and after the freeze, the missing approval, the switch off, short or foreign payments, and an unpaid pledge staying out of gifts received. Not done here and not claimed: the D8 sign-off (FH-045), issuing the provider invoice to the sponsor, and a live acceptance run, which moved to FH-047T.
